pages.title: Caffeine Cubed
pages.text: Welcome to $(thing)Caffeine Cubed$(), a mod all about coffee: growing it, roasting it, grinding it, brewing it and, of course, drinking it.$(br2)Every cup starts as a single $(item)Raw Coffee Bean$(), and every bean has a $(l:caffeinecubed:basics/bean_quality)quality$(/l) that follows it all the way to the cup.

pages.title: From Bush to Cup
pages.text: $(li)Find $(l:caffeinecubed:growing/raw_coffee_beans)raw beans$(/l) in jungle grass.$(li)Grow a $(l:caffeinecubed:growing/coffee_bush)Coffee Bush$(/l).$(li)Roast the beans in a $(l:caffeinecubed:roasting/coffee_roaster)Coffee Roaster$(/l).$(li)Grind them with a $(l:caffeinecubed:roasting/coffee_grinder)Coffee Grinder$(/l).$(li)Brew a cup in the $(l:caffeinecubed:coffee_machine/coffee_machine)Coffee Machine$(/l).$(li)$(l:caffeinecubed:drinks/coffee)Drink it$(/l)!
Lost this book? Make another from a book and a raw coffee bean.
